parameters.description:
`msg-to-telegram` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Telegram destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Telegram destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Telegram destinations bound per enrollment.

In Telegram, open a chat with @BotFather, send `/newbot`, and follow the prompts to create a bot and receive its token — set that as TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN. Then send your new bot a private message and visit `https://api.telegram.org/bot<TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN>/getUpdates` in a browser to read back the numeric chat ID from the response; set it as TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Telegram destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to the Telegram Bot API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Telegram destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.
